# Repair Service Images

This directory should contain specific images for each repair service.

## Required Images

Add transparent PNG images with white backgrounds for each repair type:

- `screen.png` - Screen repair service image
- `battery.png` - Battery replacement service image
- `camera.png` - Camera repair service image
- `charging-port.png` - Charging port repair service image
- `water-damage.png` - Water damage repair service image
- `diagnostics.png` - Diagnostic service image
- `speaker.png` - Speaker repair service image
- `software.png` - Software repair service image
- `back-glass.png` - Back glass repair service image
- `earpiece.png` - Earpiece repair service image
- `home-button.png` - Home button repair service image
- `back-cover.png` - Back cover repair service image

## Image Specifications

- Format: PNG with transparent background
- Size: Recommended 400x400px or larger
- Background: Transparent (will display on white background)
- Style: Royalty-free, professional device repair images

## Fallback

If a repair-specific image is not found, the system will fall back to `/images/mobile.png`.
